translations.idiomatic: The repeated raids were in fact instigated by the Doyan men Hazhou'er and Chen Tongshi.

sentences.zh: 二人者，俱中國人，被擄遂為三衛用。

translations.literal: Both men were Chinese who had been captured and then served the three guards.
translations.idiomatic: Both were Chinese captives who then served the three guards.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，韃靼俺答謀犯畿東，舟兒為指潮河川路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Tartar Altan plotted to invade the eastern capital region; Zhou'er pointed out the Chaohé River route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the Tartar Altan planned to raid the eastern capital region, and Zhou'er showed him the route along the Chaohé River.

sentences.zh: 俺答移兵白廟，近古北，舟兒詐言敵已退，邊備緩，俺答遂由鴿子洞、曹榆溝入，直犯畿甸。

translations.literal: Altan moved his troops to Baimiao near Gubei; Zhou'er falsely reported the enemy had withdrawn, border defenses slackened, and Altan then entered through Gezidong and Caoyugou, striking straight at the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Altan moved to Baimiao near Gubei. Zhou'er falsely reported that the enemy had withdrawn, border defenses slackened, and Altan entered through Gezidong and Caoyugou to raid the capital region.

sentences.zh: 已，俺答請開馬市，舟兒復往來誘阻之。

translations.literal: Later Altan requested opening of horse markets; Zhou'er again went back and forth to entice and obstruct it.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Altan sought to open horse markets, Zhou'er went back and forth to obstruct the negotiations.

sentences.zh: 三十年，薊遼總督何棟購捕至京，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year the Jili-Liaodong governor-general He Dong had him purchased and captured, brought to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Jili-Liaodong Governor-General He Dong had him captured and brought to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 朵顏通罕者，俺答子辛愛妻父也。

translations.literal: The Doyan Tonghan was the father of Altan's son Xin'ai's wife.
translations.idiomatic: The Doyan leader Tonghan was the father-in-law of Altan's son Xin'ai.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，古北哨卒出關，為朵顏所撲殺。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Gubei sentry soldiers went out of the pass and were set upon and killed by the Doyan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year Gubei sentry soldiers who went beyond the pass were ambushed and killed by the Doyan.

sentences.zh: 俄通罕叩關索賞，副總兵胡鎮伏兵執之。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Tonghan came to the pass demanding rewards; Vice Regional Commander Hu Zhen ambushed and seized him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Tonghan came to the pass demanding rewards. Vice Regional Commander Hu Zhen ambushed and seized him.

sentences.zh: 總督楊選將為牽制辛愛計，乃拘縶通罕，令其諸子更迭為質。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Xuanjiang, intending a plan to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and ordered his sons to take turns as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Xuanjiang, planning to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and required his sons to serve as hostages in rotation.

sentences.zh: 三衛恨甚，遂導俺答入掠順義及三河，選得罪。

translations.literal: The three guards hated this deeply and therefore guided Altan to raid Shunyi and Sanhe; Xuan was punished for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: The three guards were furious and guided Altan to raid Shunyi and Sanhe. Yang Xuan was punished for the disaster.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初，朵顏長昂益強，挾賞不遂，數糾眾入掠，截諸蕃貢道。

translations.literal: In the early Wanli reign the Doyan Changang grew stronger; when coerced rewards failed, he repeatedly rallied masses to raid and cut off the tribute routes of various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Wanli the Doyan leader Changang grew powerful. When his demands for rewards failed, he repeatedly raided and cut off other tribes' tribute routes.

sentences.zh: 十二年秋，復導士蠻以四千騎分掠三山、三道溝、錦川諸處。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twelfth year he again guided the Tumen with four thousand cavalry to raid separately at Sanshan, Sandao Gou, Jinchuan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twelfth year he again guided the Tumen with four thousand horsemen to raid Sanshan, Sandao Gou, Jinchuan, and other places.

sentences.zh: 守臣李松請急剿長昂等，朝議不從，僅革其月賞。

translations.literal: The defending official Li Song requested urgent suppression of Changang and others; court deliberation did not agree, and only their monthly rewards were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Defending official Li Song urged an immediate campaign against Changang, but the court refused and merely cut his monthly stipend.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復以千騎犯劉家口，官軍御之，殺傷相當。

translations.literal: Before long he again with a thousand cavalry violated Liujiakou; government troops resisted, and casualties were about equal.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he raided Liujiakou with a thousand horsemen. Government troops resisted, and casualties were roughly equal.

sentences.zh: 於是長昂益跋扈自恣，東勾土蠻，西結婚白洪大，以擾諸邊。

translations.literal: Thereupon Changang grew still more overbearing and unrestrained, linking east with the Tumen and marrying west with Bai Hongda, to disturb the various borders.
translations.idiomatic: Changang grew still more overbearing, allied with the Tumen in the east and married into Bai Hongda's family in the west, and harassed the borders on every side.

sentences.zh: 十七年合韃靼東西二部寇遼東，總兵李成梁逐之，官軍大敗，殲八百人。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the eastern and western Tartar divisions together raided Liaodong; Regional Commander Li Chenliang pursued them, and the government army suffered a great defeat with eight hundred annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the eastern and western Tartars together raided Liaodong. Regional Commander Li Chenliang pursued them, and the army was routed with eight hundred killed.

sentences.zh: 又二年大掠獨石路。

translations.literal: Two years later they raided heavily along the Dushi route.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later they raided heavily along the Dushi route.

sentences.zh: 二十二年復擁眾犯中後所，攻入小屯台，副總兵趙夢麟、秦得倚等力戰卻之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year they again massed troops to violate Zhonghousuo, entered Xiaotuntai, and Vice Regional Commanders Zhao Menglin, Qin Deyi, and others fought hard to drive them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year they again attacked Zhonghousuo and broke into Xiaotuntai. Vice Regional Commanders Zhao Menglin and Qin Deyi fought hard and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 明年潛入喜峰口，官軍擒其頭目小郎兒。

translations.literal: The following year they secretly entered Xifeng Pass; government troops captured their chief Xiaolang'er.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they slipped into Xifeng Pass, and government troops captured their chief Xiaolang'er.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，長昂與董狐狸等皆納款，請復寧前木市，許之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Changang, Dong Huli, and others all submitted and requested restoration of the Ningqian timber market; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Changang, Dong Huli, and others submitted and asked to reopen the Ningqian timber market. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三十四年冬，復糾韃靼班不什、白言台吉等，以萬騎迫山海關，總兵姜顯謨擊走之。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirty-fourth year he again rallied the Tartars Banbushi, Baiyan Taiji, and others, with ten thousand cavalry pressing on Shanhai Pass; Regional Commander Jiang Xianmo struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirty-fourth year he rallied Banbushi, Baiyan Taiji, and others with ten thousand horsemen against Shanhai Pass. Regional Commander Jiang Xianmo drove them off.

sentences.zh: 長昂復以三千騎窺義院界，邊將有備，乃引去。

translations.literal: Changang again with three thousand cavalry probed the Yiyuan border; border generals were prepared, and he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Changang probed the Yiyuan border with three thousand horsemen, but border commanders were ready and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 旋詣喜峰，自言班、白入寇，己不預知。

translations.literal: He soon came to Xifeng and declared that Ban and Bai had invaded without his foreknowledge.
translations.idiomatic: He soon came to Xifeng and claimed he had known nothing of Ban and Bai's raid.

sentences.zh: 守臣具以聞，詔長昂復貢市，頒給撫賞如例。

translations.literal: The defending officials reported in full; an edict restored Changang's tribute markets and issued pacification rewards according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials reported this, and the court restored Changang's tribute markets and issued pacification rewards as usual.

sentences.zh: 長昂死，諸子稍衰，三衛皆靖。

translations.literal: When Changang died, his sons gradually declined, and the three guards all became tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: After Changang's death his sons declined, and the three guards grew quiet.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，與插漢戰於早落兀素，勝之，殺獲萬計，以捷告。

translations.literal: In the early Chongzhen reign they fought the Chakhar at Zaoluo Wusu, defeated them, and killed and captured by the tens of thousands, reporting the victory.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongzhen they fought the Chakhar at Zaoluo Wusu, won a great victory with tens of thousands killed or captured, and reported their triumph.

sentences.zh: 未幾，皆服屬於大清雲。

translations.literal: Before long they all submitted to the Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they all submitted to the Great Qing.
